signals.title: ECB en EU centrale banken willen MiCA-depositorequirements voor stablecoins aanpassen
signals.summary: The ECB and EU central banks want to replace MiCA’s stablecoin bank-deposit requirements with liquidity thresholds, warning that sudden withdrawals could strain lenders.

signals.title: EBA publiceert ontwerpmethodologie voor boeterollen onder MiCA
signals.summary: ​The European Banking Authority (EBA) published today a Consultation Paper with a draft methodology for setting fines in its role as supervisor under MiCA. The objective is to ensure that fines imposed on issuers of significant crypto-assets are consistent, proportionate and transparent, and effectively support compliance with the regulatory framework.

signals.title: Stablecoin-infrastructuurbedrijf Avenia haalt 25 miljoen dollar op
signals.summary: Lightspeed Faction led the equity round, bringing Avenia's total funding to $44.6 million as it plans new products and acquisitions.

signals.summary:
Anon Intel Officials: Iran Could Detonate Dirty Bomb Or Chemical Weapon In D.C. 

              A  who's who of top Trump administration officials and their families are currently    living on military bases  around Washington D.C. on fears that Iranian intelligence or Iran-linked agents could move to attack or assasinate them.    This growing list includes Attorney General Todd Blanche, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth, White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller, Army Secretary Dan Driscoll, former Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem, former Attorney General Pam Bondi, and former Navy Secretary John Phelan.   
   
  Getty Images  
 
 This heightened state of security for these current and (some of them) former government officials is due to undefined threats reported to be  "linked"  to Tehran in some way. So far nothing specific has been made public, but on Monday a CNN report has  dialed up the threat level 100x .  Amer
